test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held On: 30 June, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A football team won 10 games from the total they played. This was 40% of the total. How many games were played in all?
solution:
**Given:**

No. of games won = 10

% of won games = 40% of the total games

**Concept used:**

a% of b = b × a/100

**Calculation:**

Let, total no. of games = x

According to the question,

x × 40/100 = 10

⇒ x × 4/10 = 10

⇒ x = 10 × 10/4 = 100/4 = 25

∴ 25 games were played in all.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__ **

Let, total games = 100%

⇒ 40% = 10

⇒ 100% = 10/40 × 100 = 25 

**∴ 25 games were played in all.**
